notes: two isnads, two sayings: the parable («إن مثل المنفق») runs through أبو الزناد والأعرج and is saying 1, the first in the text; Tawus's report of Abu Hurayra's gesture («يشير بيده وهو يوسعها») runs through the chain written first and is saying 2
«يقول أبو هريرة أشهد أنه رأى...» is a Companion's remark inside saying 1, with no isnad of its own; it is not a group
«ثم قال حدثنا» continues Muhammad ibn Mansur's narration, so the head is shared
